risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed year-over-year operational metrics, but it acknowledges a material industry-wide demand slowdown, affordability pressure, rising mortgage rates, backlog declines, and prior-period impairments. Management maintains a cautiously confident tone, emphasizing land strategy, margins, liquidity, and perceived resilience while relying on forward-looking assumptions about demand and economic conditions.
